annotation.title_clean: Council Directive (EU) 2020/2020 of 7 December 2020 amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards temporary measures in relation to value added tax applicable to COVID-19 vaccines and diagnostic medical devices in response to the COVID-19 pandemic
annotation.title_en: Council Directive (EU) 2020/2020 of 7 December 2020 amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards temporary measures in relation to value added tax applicable to COVID-19 vaccines and diagnostic medical devices in response to the COVID-19 pandemic
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 419/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Council Directive amending the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC to let Member States apply reduced VAT rates or deductible exemptions to COVID-19 vaccines and diagnostic medical devices until 31 December 2022. It has no connection to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States may apply a reduced VAT rate or deductible exemption to COVID-19 diagnostic devices
Vaccines authorised by the Commission or Member States may be exempt with deductibility
Diagnostic devices must conform to Directive 98/79/EC or Regulation (EU) 2017/746
